Event.stop: Token ends its move on tile

EventHint.enter: Fires the moment a token's centre (or any part, see Detection) reaches the tile. With “Stop movement” a longer drag is cut short so the token stops on the first space inside.
EventHint.exit: Fires when a token leaves the tile.
EventHint.stop: Fires when a token comes to rest on the tile (at the end of a move).
EventHint.turnStart: Fires when a combatant's turn starts while its token stands on the tile.
EventHint.turnEnd: Fires when a combatant's turn ends while its token stands on the tile.
EventHint.click: Fires when someone clicks the tile on the Tokens layer with one of their tokens close enough (see Click range). Good for levers, chests and doors.
EventHint.manual: Only fires from the ▶ button here, or from a macro: game.modules.get("dxcufgbs-tile-triggers").api.fire(tile, "name").

Trigger.StopMovementHint: If the token was dragged further, it stops on the first space inside the tile.
Trigger.ClickRangeHint: How close the clicking player's token must be. 0 = standing on the tile, 1 = next to it.

Option.DetectCenter: Token centre is on the tile
Option.DetectOverlap: Any part of the token is on the tile
